[2026-09-17 | AMZN | Overweight | -0.7% | -1.6% | 5d]

DECISION:
**Rating**: Overweight

**Executive Summary**: AMZN is Overweight, built in tranches toward ~1.15–1.20x a standard allocation (1.30x maximum after confirmation), not chased at the $251.19 mid-range print. First tranche at ~25–30% of the incremental overweight via limit in the $246.50–$248.00 confluence (Bollinger lower $246.62 / 2026-09-15 low $247.22) and only with a reversal filter — a close back above $249.24 or a clear reversal candle; cancel if price slices through unstabilized. Tactical hard stop $243.50, structural invalidation on a daily close below $240.20, trim zones $266.29–$267.56 then $278.09; horizon 3–6 months, re-scored at the late-October Q3 print.

**Investment Thesis**: Direction is settled; sizing and trigger discipline decided it. The aggressive analyst won the fundamental debate unrefuted: Q2 revenue $200.6B (+19.6% vs +16.6% in Q1), operating income $27.5B (+43.2%), margin 13.69% (+226bp), marketing/G&A/SBC all falling as a share of revenue with SBC down 7.6% in dollars against 19.6% revenue growth, core EPS ex the $62.8B equity marks +28.6% in Q2 / +25.1% in H1, TTM core ~$7.98. Structure is intact: price +4.57% above a rising 200 SMA at $240.20, 50 SMA $255.71 is +6.46% above it, first higher low $249.24 vs $244.30, MACD histogram −1.5387 → −1.2662, flattening 10 EMA slope, ATR compressed 9.9478 → 6.1742, and scenario weights of 45% base / 30% bull / 25% bear — a 25% tail, not the base case. The record agrees: heavy AMZN de-risking inside an intact rising 50/200 structure (07-22 to 07-30) cost 12–22% of five-day alpha.

The conservative analyst won the risk composition, and I adopt it: $247.25 is not a floor because the 2026-09-16 close at $245.96 already pierced the lower band; a $243.50 stop is ~0.6 ATR and inside normal noise, so size — not the stop — is the protection; and TTM FCF −$11.6B, capex $173B (+61%), debt+finance leases +80.5% to $146.4B, current ratio 1.033, $650B of purchase commitments and D&A +31% y/y justify staging rather than a full clip. The neutral analyst won the mechanics: the 45% base case is a retest of $246–249 then another attempt at $255–257, a path that can fill $247.25, sweep $243.50 and reverse — hence a reversal filter and a smaller first tranche (~25–30%, not 40%) — while the conservative's two-closes-above-$256.45-on->40M-with-RSI->55 bar is a momentum chase paying only ~0.9R to $266.29 against a $246.90 stop. The report's invalidation is a daily close below $244.30, so wicks are not the trigger; sizing is set so a stress gap toward $235.50 (AMZN gapped +15.32% on 2026-07-31, −5.55% on 2026-02-06) cannot breach the single-name budget, and tranche sizes are halved if a report falls in the holding period. What would change the call: upgrade to Buy on Q3 capex at or below $54.2B with margin still ≥13.7%, D&A/revenue near 10%, TTM FCF turning positive, disclosed AWS backlog, and a volume-confirmed close above $256.45 then $266.29–$267.56; downgrade toward Hold/Underweight on a daily close below $244.30 that fails to reclaim in two to three sessions, any markdown in the $122.3B non-marketable equity book, a close below $240.20 (full thesis review), or FCF staying negative while debt compounds and interest expense (+155% to $1.31B) keeps rising.

Explicitly missing and weighted at zero: no portfolio, holdings, cost basis or cash context (all sizing is a fraction of a caller-defined standard AMZN sleeve; AMZN counts as one AI-capex-correlated position alongside any NVDA or hyperscaler exposure); no AWS segment revenue, margin or backlog, so the demand side of the capex program is inference; no consensus/valuation inputs beyond ~31.5x core TTM; no options-implied volatility, skew, sentiment or insider data, so no option overlay is priced; and the news sample is a thin subset dated 2026-09-16, so the wage-floor, Fed-hike, hyperscaler-credit and data-center-power narratives carry no sizing weight.

Lesson for next time: when the base case is a retest of a confluence zone, treat post-call drift to the middle of that zone as expected noise, and judge the call on whether the trigger discipline held rather than on short-window alpha.

[2026-09-16 | AMZN | Overweight | +1.3% | -0.7% | 5d]

DECISION:
**Rating**: Overweight

**Executive Summary**: AMZN stays Overweight, but I override the trader's front end: do not take a 25% market starter at $245.96 into a widening downtrend. Deploy only 10-12% of a standard AMZN allocation, and only on a close back above the lower Bollinger Band at $246.83 with the $244.30 low holding; if the next session prints a lower close, stand aside and let $239.80-$241.00 come to you. WHAT THE BEAR AND NEUTRAL WON (why not Buy): the specific tape evidence went unanswered - MACD -2.242 vs signal -0.703 with the histogram widening three sessions running (-1.061 -> -1.302 -> -1.539); RSI 39.45 with price and RSI making lower lows together and no bullish divergence; a close 0.35% BELOW a falling lower Bollinger Band (246.83, down 5.44 points in six sessions), which is continuation, not a band tag; the 50 SMA slope collapsed to +0.0004/day; a 10 EMA/50 SMA cross on 9/15; price below the 10 EMA (253.07) and VWMA (255.62) with trapped supply at 253-256; and 9/15 underperformance at -2.09%. Cap the starter at 10-12% of a standard allocation, gate it on a close above $246.83 with $244.30 holding, and size so a gap through $235 costs ~0.5-0.75% of equity rather than the trader's 1.5%. Then let the ladder carry the thesis: 35-40% in $239.80-$241.00 (July 30 gap origin, rising 200 SMA at 240.11, ~1x ATR) on a green reversal day above $243 on >40M shares; 20-25% only on a close above $257.19 with $261.12 confirmation; 10% held for $267.56.
